name: store
title: Store
description: pal.cagdas.io's extension list in the panel: search by name, tagline or category, read the description, screenshots and keys in the detail pane, install with Enter. What is installed is tagged, and a store extension the site has a newer version of leads under Updates.
author: pal

store.tagline: Browse and install extensions without leaving the panel
features: Every extension pal.cagdas.io lists, with its tile, tagline and chips (menu bar, links, accounts), narrowed by what you type
The dropdown filters to Installed, Updates, or one of the site's shelves (Productivity, Developer, System, Media, Reference, Fun, Integration)
The detail pane (`cmd+i`) shows the description, what it does, the screenshots and the keys of each palette, with the author, version, licence and permissions
Enter installs an absent extension after a confirm: the HUD says Installing…, the host restarts, the root opens with the name typed
A store-installed extension the site has a newer version of leads under Updates; Enter updates it, `ctrl+x` removes it
The list is fetched once an hour and kept across restarts; `cmd+r` fetches now; offline, the last list is shown with a note, or one row says the site is not reachable
